description: Second language, same judgements. Both findings come from policies written against TypeScript corpora, with no policy change: only a classification rule for Flask's request global and two channel descriptions.

expected.note: same internal-detail-outward policy that covers Express responses and outbound webhooks

LOW because .get() cannot be resolved without type inference; the capability gap shows up as confidence, not as silence (ADR-003/005); an attribute chain is read to its root now instead of falling through to unresolved, which is what lifts this off the floor -- medium rather than high because a chain more than one attribute past an imported name is a name and not a type
